Author: KringleKiller

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
This mod is a compaion mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42940]Skip or Socialize - Replace Skip Button For Important Events (Dialogue Helper - UI Support)[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/DylanJames]DylanJames[/url]. 

This is the first mod I've ever made. I can't enjoy SDV without a controller and I got tired of swapping back and forth for each cutscene, so I decided to learn something new and solve my own problems. Along the way, I discovered others had the same problem and I decided to share. 

While making this mod, I also had to learn Python, MS VS, and several other skills I didn't have before. There will be bugs. I may or may not update as I find them, depending on when\if the offical mod gets native controller support.

As it is, I've played 50ish successful hours with this mod, issues free.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Use Vortex or drop extracted folder into "Stardew Valley\Content\Mods". Ensure you have  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42940]Skip or Socialize - Replace Skip Button For Important Events[/url] installed as well.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds controller support to Skip or Socialize. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
